summary: Blue Owl Real Estate Net Lease Trust filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 1,767,877 Class I common shares to feeder vehicles for gross proceeds of approximately $18.9 million, based on July 31, 2026 NAV. The sale was exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D and/or Regulation S. The filing also discloses NAV per share by class as of July 31, 2026, ranging from $10.4938 (Class D) to $10.7302 (Class N), with total NAV of $9.67 billion. This is a routine capital raise and NAV disclosure for a non-traded REIT, not a special situation.
